newsitem.title: JAMAICA: Jamaican bauxite firms merge operations.
newsitem.headline: Jamaican bauxite firms merge operations.

text.p: Two of Jamaica's major bauxite-refining operations have announced plans to consolidate their mining operations in a cost-cutting measure, company officials said Monday.

Jamalco, a joint venture between the Jamaican government and Aluminum Co of America, and Alpart, a joint venture between the government and Kaiser Aluminum Corp, will be equity partners in the new mining venture, which will be finalized by year-end.
The new venture will mine bauxite in south-central Jamaica, in an area with estimated reserves of 100 million dry metric tonnes.
Jamalco and Alpart said they have been granted mining leases within a 7-mile (11-km) radius of one another, contributing to the decision to mine the areas jointly rather than independently.
Jamalco and Alpart said they will continue to separately process and ship from their respective plants and port facilities.
